plugins.name: notion-skills
plugins.description: Turn your Notion database into a live skill store for Claude Code. A SessionStart hook injects an index of every skill page, and the page itself is fetched at use time — no per-skill install step, and no local copy to go stale. Reads Notion with your own credentials; no telemetry.
